observed_source_findings.finding: RetainedUsesPortableArithmetic requires both actual binary32 denormal preservation and RTE. The real stock Mesa25.2.8 observations report denorm32=0,RTE32=1; portable arithmetic is the correct current route.
Authenticated25.2.8 source advertises no denormal preserve/flush control for16/32/64; RTE and signed-zero/inf/NaN preserve properties are true.
Authenticated26.2.4 source still sets shaderDenormPreserveFloat32=false. A release upgrade alone does not remove this route dependency. No upgrade build or benchmark was launched.
25.2.8 compute worker calls task->work with no explicit per-task floating-environment guard in this function; caller/worker environment still requires actual tracing.
26.2.4 explicitly switches flush-to-zero state between OpenCL kernel and graphics/compute jobs; this is actual execution machinery to inspect, not a missing app setting.

25.2.8 raster workers explicitly enable flush-to-zero; synchronous scene path saves/restores FP state. Claiming general Vulkan denormal support requires all supported shader execution paths, not only one compute sample.

Native lp_build_div uses LLVM FDiv and lp_build_sqrt uses llvm.sqrt. Existing lp_build_fpstate_set_denorms_zero can clear DAZ/FTZ on supported x86 SSE targets; its existence alone establishes no full support.
